comment: Identifier plus password, then the organization picker (issue #94, PR-B2): a multi-organization subject with no organization parameter chooses which live-and-active membership this login binds as its durable org context. The picker's render-or-skip decision and its authoritative membership reads live in the engine; the routing this transcript replays is the plain forward walk (the accepted pick advances the picker straight to the terminal). The self-contained artifact the transcripts in this directory replay against.

steps.comment: The first factor establishes the subject the picker then reads memberships for.
The organization picker: it renders the choice for a multi-org, no-parameter subject and holds until a valid pick, then advances to the terminal.
The session is minted and the picked organization is frozen onto it (issue #94, PR-B2).

transitions.comment: After the primary factor, the walk enters the organization picker.
An accepted pick advances the picker straight to the terminal mint (the single unguarded forward edge).
